title: Indo-Western Outfits With a Kurti: 8 Easy Combinations to Try
excerpt: Eight easy Indo-western outfits with a kurti: jeans, skirts, palazzos, jackets and belts that turn one kurti into many fresh, modern looks.
body:
The easiest Indo-western outfits with a kurti come from one simple idea: keep one piece Indian and make the other Western. A block printed kurti with straight jeans, an embroidered kurti with a midi skirt, a short tunic under a denim jacket. Below are eight combinations that work for brunch, office, travel and parties.

## Why Indo-western is perfect for life abroad

If you live in the USA, UK, Canada, the UAE or Australia, you probably switch between worlds many times a week. Office on Monday, a friend's mehendi on Saturday, a school pickup in between. Indo-western dressing lets one kurti travel across all of those days. It also stretches your wardrobe: a single good kurti can create five or six different outfits depending on what you pair it with.

## The 8 combinations at a glance

| # | Combination | Best for | Kurti length |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Kurti + straight jeans | Weekend, travel | Hip to thigh |
| 2 | Kurti + midi or maxi skirt | Brunch, temple, parties | Hip |
| 3 | Kurti + belt + trousers | Office, dinners | Thigh to knee |
| 4 | Kurti + denim jacket | Casual days out | Hip |
| 5 | Kurti + palazzo co-ord | Summer, holidays | Hip to thigh |
| 6 | Kurti + cigarette pants + blazer | Work meetings | Thigh |
| 7 | Long kurti as a dress + boots | Autumn and winter | Knee |
| 8 | Kurti + dhoti pants or wide shorts | Festivals, beach | Hip |

## 1 to 3: The everyday basics

**1. Kurti with straight jeans.** This is the classic for a reason. Choose a dark, straight or slightly wide-leg jean rather than a skinny fit, which can look dated with a flowing top. A short block printed piece like the [Coral Pink Hand Block Print Cotton Tunic Top](/products/coral-pink-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) with white sneakers is a perfect weekend outfit.

**2. Kurti with a skirt.** A hip-length kurti tucked loosely or worn over a flowing midi skirt looks fresh and feminine. Solid skirts work best with printed kurtis, and printed skirts with plain or embroidered kurtis. This combination is lovely for temple visits and family lunches.

**3. Kurti with a belt.** A thin leather or metal belt at the waist instantly turns a straight kurti into a shaped tunic dress. It flatters most body types and works with slim trousers. Embroidered kurtis with side tie-ups, like the [Rani Pink Embroidered Kurti](/products/rani-pink-embroidered-kurti/), already have that cinched effect built in, so you can skip the belt.

## 4 to 6: Layered and polished

**4. Kurti with a denim jacket.** On cooler days, a cropped denim jacket over a hip-length kurti looks young and relaxed. Roll the sleeves a little to show the kurti's cuffs. Ankle boots or loafers complete it.

**5. The co-ord set.** Matching top and palazzo sets are the simplest Indo-western look of all, because the outfit is already decided. The [White and Blue Floral Cotton Halter Peplum Top with Palazzo Co-ord Set](/products/white-blue-floral-cotton-halter-peplum-top-with-palazzo-co-ord-set/) has a peplum shape and halter neck that feel very Western while the print stays soft and Indian.

**6. Kurti, cigarette pants and a blazer.** For work, a thigh-length kurti with slim cigarette pants and a structured blazer is smart and confident. Keep colours calm, such as olive, navy, white or grey. The [Olive Green Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top](/products/olive-green-white-embroidered-cotton-tunic-top/) has a white floral yoke that peeks nicely above a blazer's lapels.

Browse more shorter styles in our [tunic tops](/cotton-tunic-tops-short-kurtis-for-jeans/) collection if you want a wider choice of pieces for these layered looks.

## 7 and 8: Seasonal twists

**7. Long kurti as a dress with boots.** In autumn and winter, a knee-length kurti works beautifully as a dress. Add opaque tights, knee-high or ankle boots and a long coat. This is one of the easiest ways to wear Indian prints in cold countries.

**8. Kurti with dhoti pants or wide shorts.** For a festival or a beach holiday, pair a short kurti with draped dhoti pants or relaxed linen shorts. It is playful, comfortable and photographs well. Add kolhapuri flats and a sling bag.

## Styling rules that always work

- **Balance volume.** Flowing kurti, slimmer bottom. Fitted kurti, wider bottom.
- **One hero piece.** If the kurti is embroidered, keep the bottom plain.
- **Mind the length.** Hip-length suits jeans and skirts; thigh to knee suits trousers.
- **Choose footwear by mood.** Sneakers for casual, loafers for office, juttis or heels for parties.
- **Jewellery stays simple.** One pair of statement jhumkas or a single bold ring is enough.

A kurti that fits well makes every combination easier. The [Bottle Green Embroidered Kurti](/products/green-embroidered-kurti/) and our other styles can be stitched to your bust, waist, hip and height at no extra cost.

## Frequently asked questions

**Which kurti length is best for Indo-western outfits?**
Hip to thigh length is the most versatile. It pairs with jeans, skirts, trousers and jackets without overwhelming your frame.

**Can I wear a kurti with jeans to the office?**
On casual Fridays, yes. Choose dark, clean jeans and a calm print, and add loafers or a blazer to keep it polished.

**What shoes go best with a kurti and jeans?**
White sneakers, loafers, ankle boots and juttis all work. Choose by occasion and weather.
